artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan (8.5 h) landing the anchor layer of requirement (W) -- box quantifier collapse, the (S)-shape-refuted verdict probe, the closure-wide AnchorCons object with completeness for every model, its 2^(2^|cl|) bound and a decidable Finset checker -- and recording the run layer as blocked on three named obligations; no decidability statement.

memory_candidates.content: In the BimodalLogic L+ semantics, `box` is a per-MODEL datum on every TaskFrame, not a per-time one: the history set is shift-closed (`plusTruthAt_timeShift`), so `box_iff` + a time shift gives `PlusTruthAt M τ t (.box ψ) ↔ PlusTruthAt M σ s (.box ψ)` for any histories and times (`box_global`, PlusTruth.lean). Consequences for any closure-wide / quasimodel object: `Anchored.box`'s `∀ z` quantifier is redundant, the `box`-letters of a closure object are |{box ψ ∈ cl φ}| global bits, and `stab` letters are per world state (`stab_state_only`). So the ANCHOR layer of a quasimodel over this semantics is a set of cells (sets of closure types) bounded syntactically by 2^(2^|cl φ|) with box/stab/Hintikka fixpoint equations, and ALL the untl/snce nesting lives in a separate RUN layer that must be a frame's full path set (closed under splicing and limits, `blc_plusValid`) -- unlike HWZ 2000 Def. 12, where the run set is chosen freely. Never cost the run layer from (C)/(S) figures; (S)'s finite-width `ofSlicedStep` models cannot be its soundness half (`no_finite_width_sat`), and trace-level `Presented` with a unique `now` state collapses ψ ↔ ⊡ψ at the seam.
